messages.author: cd76564ddb5e3c29
messages.subject: spatiotemporal CAR models
parts:
Dear all, 

I am new to R-INLA. 
I have been looking for a tutorial with codes to run the 4 types of interaction models detailed in (Bayesian Modelling of Inseparable Space-Time Variation in Disease Risk) by L Knorr-Held (2000).  
 I did came across some tutorials where only Type I interactions are discussed. I would appreciate it if you can direct me to codes to run the 4 types of models. 

Many thanks 

Aminath

messages.author: 30b37db3d992e3df
messages.subject: Re: spatiotemporal CAR models
parts:
INLA contains a built-in function knmodels() which does this. For a different approach (which doesn't, as far as I can see, fully account for the necessary constraints, see the "spatiotemporal" chapter of the Blangiardo+Cameletti book, which contains a fully worked out set of examples).

Regares,
